dev_extension.note: Dev-split only (every id was checked against the split rule before adding). The held-out membership hash is unchanged from the original manifest.

dev_extension_06e.note: Engineering-authored per-language text (en, de, fr, es, it, pt, nl, mixed language/script), NOT native-reviewed. Dev-split only: every id was checked against the split rule (ids only) before adding; the held-out membership hash is unchanged.

sources.authored-06e-dev: first round (used to design the 06E rules)
sources.authored-06e-dev-probe: written after the first round was frozen (generalisation probe; second-round rules were then tuned on it)

split_rule: sha256(case id) mod 100 < 30 -> heldout, else dev
tuning_rule: Detectors may be tuned on the dev split only. The held-out split is measured, never tuned against.
